title: Quantum Error Correction Below the Surface Code Threshold with Willow
author: Hartmut Neven
excerpt: Today, Google Quantum AI introduces Willow, our next-generation 105-qubit quantum processor that cuts logical error rates in half when moving from distance-3 to distance-5 and distance-7 surface codes.

title: AlphaFold 3: Accurately Predicting the Structure of All Life's Molecules
author: John Jumper & Demis Hassabis
excerpt: AlphaFold 3 models interactions across proteins, DNA, RNA, ligands, and chemical modifications with unprecedented fidelity, launching via the free AlphaFold Server for scientists worldwide.

title: Advancing Clinical Reasoning and Medical Diagnosis with Med-Gemini
author: Alan Karthikesalingam & Vivek Natarajan
excerpt: How equipping Gemini with fine-tuned web-search retrieval, specialized radiology decoders, and multimodal grounding sets new records in clinical problem-solving benchmarks.

title: GraphCast: AI Weather Forecasting in Under a Minute
author: Remi Lam & Alvaro Sanchez-Gonzalez
excerpt: Operating at 0.25-degree resolution, GraphCast predicts severe weather tracks, atmospheric river precipitation, and temperature extremes up to 10 days ahead faster and more accurately than numerical baselines.

title: From 'Attention Is All You Need' to Frontier AI: Reflections on the Transformer
author: Jeff Dean
excerpt: A look back at how an algorithmic insight in neural machine translation sparked the revolution in foundational multimodal reasoning and open research collaboration.
